notes.title: For Those experiencing crash after introduction movies
notes.notes:
Hello all. 

Some of you are experiencing crash after launching a new game. 
We are aware of this problem and will see to fix the problem. 

You can try 2 things to eventually pass the crash :

-try to launch the game as Administrator
-or delete the file 'cream.cfg' at :Steam\steamapps\common\exodus\bin\release

It may not fix the problem. 

Please leave here your infos about your configuration, cpu, ram, graphics card and your Windows version. 

The game use OpenGL for rendering and OpenAL for audio. Check if the drivers are up to date. 

Thank you for your time and patience.
